name: podnotes
description: Helps you write notes on podcasts.
author: Christian Bager Bach Houmann

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --configLoader bundle
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src tests/e2e tests/tooling scripts patches .claude/skills/verify && svelte-policy
scripts.lint:tsconfig: node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --noCheck && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --noCheck
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/obsidian-e2e.mjs test
scripts.check:a11y: node patches/svelte-check.mjs && npm run lint:tsconfig && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --tsgo-experimental-api --fail-on-warnings && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.test.json --tsgo-experimental-api --fail-on-warnings
scripts.docs:build: npm ci --prefix docs && npm run build --prefix docs
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:build && wrangler pages deploy docs/dist --project-name podnotes --branch master
scripts.format: oxfmt src tests scripts patches .claude/skills/verify .github package.json manifest.json versions.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json svelte-policy.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.e2e.config.ts vitest.setup.ts vitest.setup.dom.ts obsidian-e2e.config.mjs docs/wrangler.jsonc docs/astro.config.mjs docs/package.json docs/src/content.config.ts docs/src/markdown.ts docs/src/site.mjs docs/src/pages docs/scripts docs/legacy-fragments.json docs/tsconfig.json
